route-14-italy-politecnico-di-torino.summary: Prepare two applications: admission to PoliTO and financial support from EDISU Piemonte. The full 2027/28 calls still need checking.

sources.title: EDISU scholarship application
sources.scope: General process; next-cycle conditions to confirm

items.title: Check the 2027/28 call
items.detail: Record the programme, applicant category and deadlines when the full call is published.

items.title: Confirm the entrance test you can take
items.detail: The 2027/28 page accepts in-person TOLC@UNI and CEnT@UNI, excluding remote versions. Check venues and any alternative-test provisions before booking.

items.title: Confirm your programme and teaching language
items.detail: Check diploma acceptance, pre-graduation applications and the language requirement for the exact degree.

items.title: Prepare your academic record
items.detail: Collect school records and check which years and translations the new call requires.

items.title: Prepare graduation evidence
items.detail: Keep the final diploma, or establish which provisional school document is accepted before graduation.

items.title: Check your language certificate
items.detail: Confirm the accepted test, validity and score-reporting method for the programme.

items.title: Complete the PoliTO application
items.detail: Follow the current Apply@polito procedure and keep its confirmation.

items.title: Collect household income and asset records
items.detail: Inventory official financial documents. Confirm the required reference year and household coverage in the new EDISU call.

items.title: Check translations and legalisation
items.detail: Confirm the required Italian translations and authentication before paying for them.

items.title: Arrange access to EDISU
items.detail: Check the temporary-access-code process if you have no SPID or CIE. Access is separate from Apply@polito.

items.title: Submit the separate funding application
items.detail: Check scholarship and housing choices, attachments and submission confirmation in the current call.

items.title: Check rankings and payment conditions
items.detail: Record corrections, enrolment and first-year credit requirements. Plan for costs before funding arrives.

route-12-hungary-stipendium-hungaricum.summary: Prepare the scholarship application and the sending-partner nomination process. The reviewed application pack is for 2026/27; update it when the 2027/28 call appears.

sources.title: Stipendium Hungaricum application hub
sources.scope: Application hub; currently links the 2026/27 pack

items.title: Check the 2027/28 call
items.detail: Confirm the new cycle and your sending country's nomination procedure before relying on dates.

items.title: Choose and rank your programmes
items.detail: The previous call allowed two choices. Check eligible fields, entry requirements and language evidence for each.

items.title: Complete the sending-partner requirements
items.detail: Find your country's current nomination instructions and keep the submission confirmation.

items.title: Draft the motivation letter
items.detail: Previous format: at least one page, Times New Roman 12, in the programme language or Hungarian.

items.title: Prepare transcripts and translations
items.detail: Include completed school years and the translations required for the programme.

items.title: Prepare the diploma or missing-document declaration
items.detail: If graduating later, check the new declaration and final-upload rules before submitting.

items.title: Prepare language evidence
items.detail: Each host programme sets its minimum. Check accepted certificates and translation requirements.

items.title: Prepare passport or identity evidence
items.detail: Check the passport-data-page requirement and the process if your passport is still pending.

items.title: Prepare an application photo
items.detail: Use a recent photo meeting the new portal instructions.

items.title: Submit and keep the portal confirmation
items.detail: Review uploads and the application statement yourself before submitting.

items.title: Track university entrance assessments
items.detail: After nomination, record each host's examination or interview instructions.

items.title: Complete conditional documents after graduation
items.detail: Use the new call's final-upload deadline; last year's date is not a 2027 deadline.

items.title: Prepare the medical certificate if awarded
items.detail: The previous cycle required holders to bring it to Hungary, rather than upload it with the initial application.

route-17-italy-university-of-padua.summary: Track degree admission and the Veneto regional scholarship separately. Information Engineering is an English-taught option to investigate; the regional-aid evidence is still for 2026/27.

sources.title: Padua application procedure
sources.scope: Current application guidance; exact programme call controls

items.title: Confirm the degree and 2027 applicant call
items.detail: Review Information Engineering and the call for your citizenship and residence category.

items.title: Confirm the entrance test and fee
items.detail: Check the programme's CEnT-S requirement and payment instructions before paying an application fee.

items.title: Prepare an English CV
items.detail: Make the application version in PDF format.

items.title: Draft the programme motivation letter
items.detail: Explain your reasons for this particular programme.

items.title: Prepare transcripts and translations
items.detail: Upload colour scans with the required English or Italian translation.

items.title: Prepare your school qualification
items.detail: Check whether an enrolment or provisional certificate is appropriate while the final diploma is pending.

items.title: Prepare your passport copy
items.detail: Use the identity document required for your applicant category.

items.title: Check programme language evidence
items.detail: Verify accepted certificates and any exemption in the programme call.

items.title: Submit the degree application
items.detail: Review uploads, programme-specific payment instructions and the confirmation.

items.title: Check the new regional scholarship call
items.detail: Confirm thresholds, deadlines and first-year conditions for 2027/28.

items.title: Arrange the correct ISEE assessment
items.detail: For a household abroad, check ISEE parificato with the university's affiliated CAF and obtain its document list.

items.title: Confirm the benefits request in Uniweb
items.detail: The previous process required the fee-reduction request, ISEE and completed enrolment. Keep the saved request.

items.title: Check enrolment, first payment and credit conditions
items.detail: Plan the gap before payment; review the credits needed to retain aid.

route-30-south-korea-kaist.summary: Use the 2027 international undergraduate guide. Admission and the scholarship request belong to the same application; document preparation still has its own steps.

items.title: Check eligibility for your intake
items.detail: Confirm nationality and graduation timing in the 2027 guide.

items.title: Choose the application track
items.detail: Record application, document and recommendation dates separately. Check the Dates tab.

items.title: Draft the application essays
items.detail: Use the 2027 prompts and portal limits.

items.title: Prepare official school transcripts
items.detail: Include the final two or three years, including current coursework; attach certified English translations when needed.

items.title: Prepare passport or national ID
items.detail: Use a clear copy showing nationality.

items.title: Arrange official test scores
items.detail: At least one accepted test is required. SAT/AP/ACT require agency reporting; check delivery time.

items.title: Prepare English test evidence
items.detail: Check validity and the guide's reporting instructions.

items.title: Select the KAIST Scholarship request
items.detail: Check the financial-support selection and continuation conditions.

items.title: Complete the application and check receipt
items.detail: Review documents, fee payment and portal status.

items.title: Arrange up to two recommendations
items.detail: Optional but recommended in 2027. Recommenders submit directly through KAIST's link.

items.title: Select supported honours and awards
items.detail: Up to five; attach evidence.

items.title: Prepare school context
items.detail: Consider the optional school profile and school report.

items.title: Prepare final authenticated documents
items.detail: Check final diploma, transcripts and any test-document authentication requested after admission.

items.title: Check arrival and visa funding
items.detail: Review the post-admission financial evidence and costs before accepting.

route-35-türkiye-türkiye-scholarships.summary: Prepare a Türkiye Scholarships application with university and programme preferences. The general rules are available; confirm the 2027 call and each programme's requirements.

sources.title: Türkiye Scholarships eligibility
sources.scope: General undergraduate criteria; 2027 call to confirm

items.title: Check age, grades and graduation timing
items.detail: General bachelor's criteria include under 21, at least 70% academic achievement, and graduation before August. Confirm the new call.

items.title: Choose available engineering programmes
items.detail: Check teaching language, admission tests and the programmes offered to you in TBBS.

items.title: Review the Turkish-language year
items.detail: The published policy includes a language year for awardees without C1 Turkish, including English-programme students.

items.title: Prepare identity evidence
items.detail: Use a valid national ID or passport.

items.title: Prepare a recent photo
items.detail: The general checklist asks for a photo from the past year.

items.title: Prepare school transcripts
items.detail: Check readable scans and the portal's language instructions.

items.title: Prepare graduation evidence
items.detail: Check which provisional evidence is accepted if your final diploma is pending.

items.title: Prepare exam results if applicable
items.detail: Include national results and international tests required by the selected programme.

items.title: Check each programme's accepted language proof
items.detail: Confirm the exact accepted test; an existing certificate may not meet every programme's rule.

items.title: Prepare motivation and activity evidence
items.detail: Relate your interests, programme preferences and activities to the selection criteria.

items.title: Review and submit through TBBS
items.detail: Confirm the current application window and keep the submission record.

items.title: Prepare for tests or an interview if shortlisted
items.detail: Review the published undergraduate assessment and interview process.
